purpose: Предлагаемое визуальное оформление состояний; самостоятельные AI-мокапы, не runtime-скриншоты
sharedArtDirection:
Use case: ui-mockup. Deliver a single finished full-screen mobile game UI mockup, portrait 9:16, ideally 1080 by 1920 pixels. Full bleed app screen only, no phone frame, no desk, no perspective device, no presentation sheet. Game is Magnet Sort, an original Three.js 3D hex sorting puzzle for casual Facebook Instant Games audience.
Art direction: polished cheerful mass-market casual puzzle game, jewel-toned purple to royal-blue softly luminous background with very subtle hex pattern, ivory ceramic honeycomb tiles with rounded beveled rims, candy-like glossy extruded hexagonal ring tiles with a small central hole, vivid violet, sky blue and coral-orange, rich clean silhouette, warm ivory beveled panels, very readable dark plum text, chunky friendly rounded typography, large tactile green primary buttons, violet secondary controls, restrained gold accent. Soft 3D studio lighting and gentle contact shadows. Bright and readable, premium finished game art, not a corporate dashboard, not a dark technical demo, not flat wireframe. Original visual identity, no competitor logos, no Facebook logo.
Faithful game rules: player places horseshoe MAGNETS, never adds stacks from a tray. Board is a coherent 5x5 odd-r honeycomb of 25 hexagonal cells, presented by a fixed inclined camera; stacks have individually visible thin ring pieces and can mix colors bottom-to-top. Blockers have a raised X. Only exposed top pieces matching the magnet color move. Every transfer crosses exactly ONE neighboring cell. Six collected units disappear at the magnet. No coins, lives, hearts, currencies, ads, unimplemented social controls, invented boosters, star ratings, or extra menus.
Stable composition: top safe margin with small original horseshoe logo and title 'MAGNET SORT', level badge 'УРОВЕНЬ 3', small round pause control. Under this, a compact ivory goal bar 'ОЧИЩЕНО 0 / 18' with progress and a separate 'ХОДЫ 5' badge. The 3D board dominates the central half of screen; keep real comfortable empty-cell placement targets. Beneath the board a short contextual instruction. At bottom an ivory/lavender dock with exactly THREE large horseshoe magnet buttons: violet with diamond symbol, blue with dot, coral with plus. Purple selected outline on violet button. Bottom small 'Подсказка' and 'Заново' secondary buttons. All critical controls inside safe area. Typography in Russian Cyrillic except the game logo. Crisp spacing, concise accurate labels, high fidelity. Do not use decorative text paragraphs or tiny illegible type.

screens.brief: Loading/boot concept. Preserve the same art direction as the gameplay family.

screens.label: Поле готово
screens.brief: Neutral ready/playing state. Exact default level 3 HUD: 'ОЧИЩЕНО 0 / 18', 'ХОДЫ 5'. 25-cell 5x5 honeycomb, two slate X blockers at back center and front center; three mixed stacks: left rear blue below violet, right rear coral below blue, left front violet below coral. screens.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: a generated bright purple Magnet Sort mobile game screen. Image 2 is a supporting gameplay LAYOUT AND GAME DATA reference from the actual prototype, NOT a style reference.
Make a targeted correction to Image 1. Keep its polished cheerful casual game style, exact logo, background, typography, header, Russian labels, buttons, magnet dock and overall composition unchanged. Correct ONLY the central board and ring pieces so they represent the actual game.
The board must be EXACTLY 25 cells: FIVE ROWS, EACH ROW HAS FIVE hexagonal cells. Stagger alternate rows by half a cell in a coherent 5x5 odd-r honeycomb as in Image 2. Do NOT make a 3-4-5-4-3 board (19 cells) or a hexagon-shaped board. The left and right outlines are staggered but each row stays 5 cells long. Ensure all 25 are clearly shown, no hidden extra cells.
There are exactly 3 mixed stacks, each of exactly SIX thin wafer-like hexagonal ring elements, not two thick donuts. Rear-left stack = 3 blue at the bottom plus 3 violet on top; rear-right stack = 3 coral bottom plus 3 blue top; front-left = 3 violet bottom plus 3 coral top. Every thin ring layer is visibly separated, full count = 18 elements. A ring element is about 1/6 of the full stack height. Two slate X blocker cells at back-row center and front-row center. Position stacks/blockers according to Image 2.
Retain Image 1's ivory tile materials, glossy bright ring colors and gold UI rims. Make board fit naturally between goal bar and instruction. No added text, currencies, stars, lives, ads or marketing panels. Full bleed portrait 9:16 one screen.

screens.label: Допустимое размещение
screens.brief: Valid magnet placement preview. Same family and level 3 board, untouched stacks. Selected violet horseshoe magnet is hovering just above a free central hex cell, the cell has a mint-green rim and soft target glow. A subtle translucent violet guide line from the dock magnet to the free target, no motion of stacks yet. A small fingertip/hand gesture at the hovering magnet. Instruction 'Отпусти — магнит притянет цвет'. Goal 'ОЧИЩЕНО 0 / 18', moves 'ХОДЫ 5'. Three magnet buttons below.

screens.label: Недопустимое размещение
screens.brief: Invalid placement state. Same game screen and board. Violet horseshoe magnet preview overlaps an OCCUPIED violet stack cell; only that tile has a friendly coral-red rim and small X badge. Tooltip near that target reads 'Здесь уже есть стопка'. Bottom instruction 'Выбери пустую клетку'. Goal remains 'ОЧИЩЕНО 0 / 18', moves remains 'ХОДЫ 5'; invalid placement must not spend a move. No dialog, no flying pieces, no destruction, no red full-screen error.
screens.prompt:

The floating object ABOVE the occupied violet/blue stack at upper left is currently another violet stack. REPLACE ONLY that floating object with a SINGLE VIOLET HORSESHOE MAGNET, the same U-shaped tool with TWO WHITE TIPS and SMALL DIAMOND symbol as the violet button in the bottom dock. The player drags MAGNETS, never stacks. Preserve the curved dashed placement pointer, occupied target red rim/X and tooltip 'Здесь уже есть стопка'. No flying ring pieces anywhere. This is an invalid placement preview, no action happened and no stack moves. Full portrait screen.

screens.label: Притяжение по одному
screens.brief: Action resolution, the core hero image. Violet horseshoe magnet stands on an empty center cell. A source stack in an immediately neighboring hex cell is peeling its violet top layer. Show THREE separate individual violet thin hex ring pieces staggered along the SAME short low arc from source to that single adjacent destination, each at a different flip angle (flat/edge-on/tilted), clearly a rapid sequential one-piece-at-a-time transfer. Source retains lower blue layers. Destination has only already-landed violet pieces, no ghost duplicates. No entire stack floating as one object, no multihop arc. Magnet stays visible at the collection cell. Goal 'ОЧИЩЕНО 0 / 18', moves 'ХОДЫ 4'. Instruction 'Притягиваем по одному…'. Dock buttons visibly dim/locked during animation. Soft motion streaks are short and restrained.
screens.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this existing portrait Magnet Sort screen. Preserve EVERYTHING except the tiny local coral transfer illustration in the lower-left board area.
Important correction: the small coral horseshoe magnet is currently TWO CELLS to the right of the violet source stack. MOVE that small board magnet EXACTLY ONE HEX CELL LEFT, into the EMPTY HEX TILE DIRECTLY BETWEEN its current position and the violet source. The new magnet center must be approximately pixel (395, 872) in this 941x1672 image. This tile SHARES AN EDGE with the source tile centered near (225, 872). Its old tile centered near (550,872) must become empty.
Shorten the THREE floating coral ring pieces and their trail so the whole hop spans ONLY source (225,872) to new magnet tile (395,872). Approximate three ring centers: (265,815), (310,790), (360,815). Different flip angles, short low arc. No part of the flight crosses the newly empty old magnet tile at (550,872). Keep exactly THREE flying individual thin coral rings.
Source stack contains only THREE violet layers, remove the orange/coral layer accidentally sandwiched inside this source stack. All other stacks, blockers, board tiles, header, text, HUD, large three-magnet bottom dock, selected coral button and buttons remain exactly unchanged.
This is a tiny positional correction, not a new design. Output ONE full portrait screen.

screens.label: Очистка группы
screens.brief: Clear payoff moment after exactly SIX violet pieces have collected at the magnet cell. At the center target, show a compact six-layer violet ring stack just dissolving upward into a handful of violet and golden sparkles, with a crisp floating '+6' badge. Other stacks and blockers remain still and intact. Goal bar now 'ОЧИЩЕНО 6 / 18', moves 'ХОДЫ 3'. Instruction 'Шесть собрались — место свободно!'. No huge explosion, no board-wide destruction, no star rating or coins. Dock stays dim until this animation finishes.
